description.text: Main Courses: Intermediate Chinese Course, Intermediate spoken Chinese, Intermediate Listening Course, Newspapers Reading, Writing, and HSK for both intermediate and advanced tests. Features: Focus on practicing Sentence patterns and Intermediate listening and spoken Chinese.Focus on practicing Sentence patterns and Intermediate listening and spoken Chinese. Average Students: about 10 Study Duration: half year or one year Tuition: RMB 6500 for one semester; and RMB 13000 for one year

duration.text: The Intermediate Chinese Training Courses at Hunan University Of Technology and Business is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 902 USD/per semester ￥ 6500 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: Applicants should be 18-60 years old with good health
